
Diet: Cats are obligate carnivores, meaning they must eat meat
to survive and get necessary nutrients.Sleep: They sleep for about 12 to 16 hours
every day to save energy.Senses: Cats have great night vision and ears that can turn
180 degrees to pinpoint sounds.Physical traits: Most cats have 18 toes (five on each
front paw and four on each back paw) and retractable claws.History: Humans and cats
formed a friendly relationship over 10,000 years ago when cats started hunting rodents
